prompt: At night, while their owner sleeps in a bedroom, three cats march in loudly playing tiny brass instruments, then abruptly file out.

default.description: Model-default topology; validate before publishing on hardware without a dedicated profile below.
default.notes: Mirrors the cookbook's 4x-class Ulysses4 resident recipe scaled to num_gpus; NOT validated at num_gpus=2 -- validate (incl. OOM risk) before publishing.
default.policy_exception: Correctness exception, not a speed tradeoff: MiniMax-H3's torch.compile path changes numerical output per the sglang cookbook (docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx, checked 2026-08-07) -- compile is not enabled by any recommended lossless preset for this model and must not be used to generate consistency ground truth. --enable-torch-compile stays false in every profile for this case until upstream fixes the numerics.

rtx5090-2gpu.description: 2x RTX 5090 (32 GB) layerwise-offload recipe -- the lightweight, broadly-runnable topology for this case.
rtx5090-2gpu.serve_args: --model-type diffusion --warmup-mode server --model-variant fl2va --tp-size 2 --ulysses-degree 1 --performance-mode memory --layerwise-offload-components dit,text_encoder,vae --dit-offload-prefetch-size 1 --dit-layerwise-resident-layers 20 --enable-torch-compile false
rtx5090-2gpu.notes: Matches docs/cookbook/diffusion/MiniMax/MiniMax-H3.mdx's verified 2xRTX5090/32GB/377GiB-host recipe as-is. The recorded numbers below (612.65s/556.79s/23366MB) were captured 2026-08-07 on minimax-h3-5090-2gpu-v4 from a run that used --dit-offload-prefetch-size 0 instead of 1, chosen at the time because prefetch-size 1 had intermittently deadlocked at 'Loading MiniMaxH3DiTModel ... Run:ai Model Streamer' on a minority of launches. That deadlock's real cause turned out to be unrelated to prefetch-size -- LayerwiseOffloadManager.__init__ clamps prefetch_size to min(max(1, prefetch_size), num_layers), so 0 and 1 are runtime-identical, and the 0-vs-1 correlation was coincidence (page-cache warmth carried over across attempts). The actual root cause: runai_model_streamer issues an unconditional torch.distributed collective (new_group + all_gather_object) inside find_local_ranks() on the first stream_files() call per component per rank, regardless of the is_distributed argument sglang passes (always False here); any per-rank divergence in layerwise-offload load order or timing can call that ad-hoc group out of lockstep and hang. Fixed at the sglang layer in sgl-project/sglang#33969 (monkeypatches find_local_ranks to skip the collective) -- serve_args here now uses the cookbook's prefetch-size 1 since 0 was never actually load-bearing; re-validate this cell once that PR lands to confirm the hang no longer reproduces even under adversarial per-rank timing. Client wall 612.65s, server-reported inference_time_s 556.79, peak_memory_mb 23366 (well under the 32 GB budget). --performance-mode speed excluded: H3's compile path changes numerics, and speed mode's residency assumption does not fit 32 GB without the layerwise knobs above. Single-GPU (num_gpus=1, tp_size=1) at this exact shape (1344x768, 124 frames) OOMs even at resident-layers=20 -- TP2's per-rank activation footprint (measured ~13 GB/rank at 100% util during a real denoise) roughly doubles unsharded on 1 GPU, on top of a 32 GB card already near its edge per the cookbook's own 2-GPU peak (~31.7 GiB/rank); the case is 2-GPU-only until that's independently reworked.
rtx5090-2gpu.policy_exception: Same correctness exception as the default profile (checked 2026-08-07): MiniMax-H3's torch.compile path changes numerical output per the sglang cookbook, so it is excluded regardless of hardware.

default.description: vLLM-Omni's own 2-GPU MiniMax-H3 recipe (TP2, distributed layerwise offload). Reaches health and accepts a request, then crashes during generation -- kept for provenance, not a working profile.
default.framework_ref: vllm-omni recipes/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3.md (2-GPU section); installed from git main (0.26.1.dev45+g24ede9e22) + vllm==0.26.0, not the repo's default pinned vllm-omni==0.18.0
default.notes: Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe on PATH for MP4 muxing. The request also needs `aspect_ratio` inside extra_params (the recipe's own T2VA example omits it and 422s with 'RuntimeError: t2va requires an explicit aspect_ratio' as written).

enforce-eager.description: Same recipe with --enforce-eager, tried after the default profile segfaulted -- also fails, differently. Kept for provenance only.
enforce-eager.notes: Crashes during server startup (EOFError: a diffusion worker process dies before completing its init handshake) rather than during generation.

vllm-omni.reason: Empirically validated 2026-08-07 on minimax-h3-5090-2gpu-v4 (2x RTX 5090): the default profile boots, passes health, and accepts a corrected request (needs explicit aspect_ratio -- see command_profiles.default.notes), then hard-crashes 1 step into denoising with a native segfault whose Python trace runs through torch Dynamo's custom_eval_frame, despite the recipe's own claim that torch.compile is 'not enabled by default on consumer paths.' Adding --enforce-eager to rule out compile does not fix it -- the server instead fails at startup with a different error (a diffusion worker process dies before completing its init handshake, surfaced to the parent as EOFError on the worker's pipe). Both failures reproduce cleanly and neither is a request- or config-shape issue on this side; this reads as a vLLM-Omni MiniMax-H3 stability bug on this GPU class, not something fixable from the benchmark harness.

lightx2v.reason: No MiniMax-H3 pipeline in LightX2V as of 2026-08; a turbo LoRA effort for H3 was blocked by the model license's territory clause (excludes EU/UK/South Korea/US), not by missing engineering support.

trtllm-visual.reason: trtllm-visual's tracked scope in this harness is image cases; H3 is a video+audio model.

diffusers.reason: MiniMax-H3 is integrated as Modular Diffusers blocks only (no DiffusionPipeline), and only via an unmerged PR (huggingface/diffusers#14355 -- pip install git+.../diffusers.git@refs/pull/14355/head). Not a servable baseline path today.
